a: Paystack is a popular Nigerian payment gateway for accepting cards and transfers online.
Flutterwave is an African payment technology company widely used in Nigeria.
Interswitch is a Nigerian digital payments and switching company.
NIBSS operates shared payment infrastructure in Nigeria including NIP transfers.
NIP is Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System Instant Payment for fast bank transfers.
USSD banking lets customers do transactions with codes like *737# without mobile data.
Nigeria has a large fintech scene covering payments, lending, savings, and business tools.
Lagos is Nigeria's main tech hub with startups, hubs, and investors.
Andela is a well-known company that trained and placed software engineers across Africa.
Notable Nigerian startups have operated in payments, logistics, energy, and commerce.
Nigeria has data protection rules; the NDPR/framework governs personal data handling.
CAC is the Corporate Affairs Commission for registering companies in Nigeria.
TIN is a Tax Identification Number used for tax administration in Nigeria.
Payment APIs in Nigeria typically support cards, bank transfer, USSD, and sometimes wallets.
POS agents and terminals are widely used for cash-in/cash-out and card payments in Nigeria.
Mobile money and wallet services complement banks for everyday payments in Nigeria.
